description:
Failed once in the full gate on 2026-11-09 at 57bc5828 (Swift suite, load 7.6): `sidebar.drawnRows.allSatisfy { $0.width == SidebarModel.width }` at Tests/MusterMacTests/SidebarTests.swift:1251. The Rust suite passed in the same run and nothing landed that day touches the sidebar. SidebarTests passed three times in a row on its own straight after.

The test frames the list, calls layoutSubtreeIfNeeded once and reads row widths, so a table that has not finished laying out its rows when the main thread is starved can report the width it was born with. Possibly: lay out until the table's rows report the frame's width, or read the column's width rather than drawn rows. The failing row widths were not printed; adding them to the expectation would show which it was.
title: 🎲 SidebarTests theListDrawsAtItsRealWidth saw a row narrower than the list
